Processes.name: Manage Generation Portfolio
Processes.desc: Manage the generation portfolio, including refurbishment projects and sites being brought back online

children.name: Track Generation Portfolio Availability
children.desc: Monitor and record the availability status of the generation portfolio

children.name: Communicate Generation Portfolio Availability
children.desc: Provide communications to site managers based on generation availability and priority plans

children.name: Create Generation Programmes
children.desc: Develop programmes to implement generation improvements

children.name: Manage Generation Programmes
children.desc: Oversee the execution of programmes for generation improvements

children.name: Plan Generation Priority
children.desc: Define and prioritize energy generation by site

Processes.name: Pricing Scenario Planning
Processes.desc: Assess different pricing scenarios to support business decisions

children.name: Analyse Market Pricing
children.desc: Evaluate market pricing trends, including competitor pricing and market fluctuations

children.name: Set Pricing Strategy
children.desc: Define and implement pricing strategies aligned with market conditions and company objectives
